risk_note: RV2 migration 0132 (FU-ORDERS-OWN-LOOKUP-INDEX; rulings D10-851 ①, D10-853, D10-889). One non-unique partial index: CREATE INDEX orders_parent_order_idx ON app.orders (app_id, parent_order_id) WHERE parent_order_id IS NOT NULL, without ONLY (as 0007), so PostgreSQL builds and attaches a child index on every existing partition in the same transaction, including the month partitions that db:partitions and the worker's partition maintenance pre-create on deployed databases, and new partitions inherit it. D10-889 replaced the ledger title's ON ONLY + orders_default + ATTACH plan (the ledger keeps its original title; the change is in a comment). The runner is one transaction, so no CONCURRENTLY: writes to orders and its partitions wait while the index builds (small before launch); lock_timeout 5s, statement_timeout 5min. No data change, no down migration. Snapshot: db/schema.sql gains the index definitions only; packages/db/src/db.gen.ts unchanged. Integration spec/db/orders and lint-migrations 136/136 pass; packages/db migrations.test 8/8. Limitation recorded as FU-TEST-PARTITIONS-BEFORE-MIGRATION: tests cannot reproduce month partitions that exist before the migration runs, so that case is held by the static assertion on the migration source.

Round 2 pass; its S2 (the regex does not accept an equivalent USING btree form) is avoided by writing the 0007 form.
